Destinations in Thailand

Pick a city first. Bangkok is the usual landing. Chiang Mai is the north hub. Phuket and Krabi share the Andaman. Samui and Phangan sit on the Gulf.

Common questions

Where should a first trip start?
Land in Bangkok. Give it two or three nights. Then fly or take the train north, or fly south once you know which monsoon window you are in.
